name: Sarah B. Rogers
current_role: Under Secretary of State for Public Diplomacy (since October 2025); nominee for CEO of the U.S. Agency for Global Media
summary: Sarah B. Rogers, a New York lawyer, was confirmed 51–47 in October 2025 as under secretary of state for public diplomacy. In March 2026 Trump nominated her to run the U.S. Agency for Global Media, Voice of America’s parent, after a federal judge ruled Kari Lake had been running it unlawfully as acting CEO; Lake said she would stay on as deputy CEO. The Senate Foreign Relations Committee held her hearing on July 30, 2026.
